findings.claim: The new reportDiagnostic wrapper (ReportIfLocatedInCompilation) drops every diagnostic whose Location is not in a source tree of this compilation. Diagnostics created with a null or Location.None location (for example MemberNeedsKey, now built with a null location when there is no syntax) are silently discarded. This could suppress diagnostics that protect users from insecure or unsupported configurations if any diagnostic is created without a location. Dropping them looks like deliberate behavior (L8), but the filter is broader than metadata-only types, so the impact needs verification.

receipt_plan.detail: Run the analyzer tests for MsgPack003/004/005/006/007/008/009/011/012/016/018 and for types in the same compilation. Any test where the diagnostic has a null or Location.None location and the expected diagnostic is now missing will fail. Also add a test with a diagnostic on a type nested in a metadata-generic.
